entries.rationale: Allow one explicit, same-Shanghai-day user-guided resume after an autonomous completed_no_publish, bind it to the named owner, and prohibit unattended jobs from reopening or publishing that terminal day. Require every daily automation to finish an 8–12-candidate research set and durable report before no-publication closure. Keep same-day signed Google Trends collection mandatory while accepting an exact candidate not_observed result for publication; never interpret that state as zero, and preserve provider missing, unavailable, or unverifiable states as explicit failures. Record the third issue as the revenue-attribution boundary: the SEO receiver is implemented and deployed, but the production shared secret and recent signed Playworlds handshake are absent, and a direct Steam CTA cannot return an exact purchase joined to seo_click_id. Do not fabricate callback evidence; a future product decision must choose a first-party Playworlds handoff for exact attribution or explicitly authorize aggregate Steam reporting.
